119template <int dim,
120 int spacedim,
121 template <int, typename>
122 typename KernelFunctionType,
123 typename RangeNumberType,
124 typename KernelNumberType,
125 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
126void
127assemble_kernel_row(
128 Vector<RangeNumberType> &row_vector,
129 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
130 &kernel,
131 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
132 const types::global_dof_index row_dof_index,
133 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &column_dof_indices,
134 const std::vector<
135 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
136 &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
137 const std::vector<
138 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
139 &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
140 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
141 dim,
142 spacedim,
143 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
144 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_handler,
145 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_handler,
146 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
147 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
148 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
149 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
150 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
151 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
152 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
153 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
154 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
155 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
156 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
157 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDAPairCellWiseScratchData<
158 dim,
159 spacedim,
160 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &scratch_data_gpu,
161 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data)
162{
163 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
164 static_assert(
165 std::is_same<
166 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type,
167 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
168
169 AssertDimension(row_vector.size(), column_dof_indices.size());
170
171 types::global_dof_index i_global_dof_index =
172 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
173 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_index] :
174 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
175 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_index]);
176 types::global_dof_index j_global_dof_index;
177
181 for (size_type j = 0; j < column_dof_indices.size(); j++)
182 {
183 j_global_dof_index = (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
184 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[column_dof_indices[j]] :
185 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
186 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[column_dof_indices[j]]);
187
188 row_vector(j) = sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_far_field_dofs(
189 kernel,
190 kernel_factor,
191 i_global_dof_index,
192 j_global_dof_index,
193 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
194 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
195 bem_values_gpu,
196 kx_dof_handler,
197 ky_dof_handler,
198 mappings,
199 material_id_to_mapping_index,
200 normal_detector,
201 scratch_data,
202 scratch_data_gpu,
203 copy_data);
204 }
205}

288 AssertDimension(row_vector.size(), column_dof_indices.size());

290 types::global_dof_index i_global_dof_index =
291 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
292 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_index] :
293 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
294 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_index]);
295 types::global_dof_index j_global_dof_index;
296
300 for (size_type j = 0; j < column_dof_indices.size(); j++)
301 {
302 j_global_dof_index = (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
303 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[column_dof_indices[j]] :
304 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
305 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[column_dof_indices[j]]);

307 row_vector(j) = sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_far_field_dofs(

335template <int dim,
336 int spacedim,
337 template <int, typename>
338 typename KernelFunctionType,
339 typename RangeNumberType,
340 typename KernelNumberType,
341 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
342void
343assemble_kernel_row(
344 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskBufferForVector<
345 dim,
346 spacedim,
347 DeviceNumberType<RangeNumberType>,
348 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &task_buffer,
349 Vector<RangeNumberType> &row_vector,
350 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
351 &kernel,
352 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
353 const types::global_dof_index row_dof_index,
354 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &column_dof_indices,
355 const std::vector<
356 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
357 &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
358 const std::vector<
359 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
360 &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
361 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
362 dim,
363 spacedim,
364 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
365 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
366 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
367 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
368 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
369 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
370 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
371 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
372 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
373 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
374 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
375 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
376 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data)
377{
378 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
379 static_assert(
380 std::is_same<
381 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type,
382 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
383
384 AssertDimension(row_vector.size(), column_dof_indices.size());
385
386 task_buffer.reinit();
387
392 types::global_dof_index i_global_dof_index =
393 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
394 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_index] :
395 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
396 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_index]);
397 types::global_dof_index j_global_dof_index;
398
402 task_buffer.starting_task_indices_for_dof_pairs_cpu[0] = 0;
403 for (size_type j = 0; j < column_dof_indices.size(); j++)
404 {
405 j_global_dof_index = (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
406 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[column_dof_indices[j]] :
407 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
408 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[column_dof_indices[j]]);
409
410 task_buffer.starting_task_indices_for_dof_pairs_cpu[j + 1] =
411 task_buffer.starting_task_indices_for_dof_pairs_cpu[j] +
412 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
413 create_sauter_quadrature_tasks_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
414 task_buffer,
415 i_global_dof_index,
416 j_global_dof_index,
417 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
418 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
419 mappings,
420 material_id_to_mapping_index,
421 normal_detector,
422 scratch_data,
423 copy_data);
424 }
425
429 task_buffer.process_tasks(
430 row_vector,
431 kernel,
432 kernel_factor,
433 bem_values_gpu,
434 ConfigAccessor::get_far_field_task_num_per_block(),
435 ConfigAccessor::get_far_field_block_size_for_quad_result_accumulation(),
436 scratch_data.cuda_stream_handle);
437}

492 std::is_same<

496 assemble_kernel_row(task_buffer,

504 bem_values_gpu,
505 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
506 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
507 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
508 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
509 mappings,
510 material_id_to_mapping_index,
511 normal_detector,
512 scratch_data,
513 copy_data);
514
515 for (size_type j = 0; j < column_dof_indices.size(); j++)
516 {

718 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
719 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[col_dof_index] :
720 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
721 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[col_dof_index]);
722
726 for (size_type i = 0; i < row_dof_indices.size(); i++)
727 {
728 i_global_dof_index = (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
729 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_indices[i]] :
730 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
731 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_indices[i]]);
732
733 col_vector(i) = sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_far_field_dofs(
734 kernel,
735 kernel_factor,
736 i_global_dof_index,
737 j_global_dof_index,
738 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
739 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
740 bem_values_gpu,
741 mappings,
742 material_id_to_mapping_index,
743 normal_detector,
744 scratch_data,
745 scratch_data_gpu,
746 copy_data);
747
748 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
749 col_vector(i) +=
750 stabilization_factor * vec(row_dof_indices[i]) * vec(col_dof_index);
751 }
752}

760template <int dim,
761 int spacedim,
762 template <int, typename>
763 typename KernelFunctionType,
764 typename RangeNumberType,
765 typename KernelNumberType,
766 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
767void
768assemble_kernel_column(
769 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskBufferForVector<
770 dim,
771 spacedim,
772 DeviceNumberType<RangeNumberType>,
773 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &task_buffer,
774 Vector<RangeNumberType> &col_vector,
775 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
776 &kernel,
777 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
778 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &row_dof_indices,
779 const types::global_dof_index col_dof_index,
780 const std::vector<
781 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
782 &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
783 const std::vector<
784 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
785 &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
786 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
787 dim,
788 spacedim,
789 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
790 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
791 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
792 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
793 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
794 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
795 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
796 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
797 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
798 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
799 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
800 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
801 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data)
802{
803 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
804 static_assert(
805 std::is_same<
806 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type,
807 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
808
809 AssertDimension(col_vector.size(), row_dof_indices.size());
810
811 task_buffer.reinit();
812
813 types::global_dof_index i_global_dof_index;
814 types::global_dof_index j_global_dof_index =
815 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
816 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[col_dof_index] :
817 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
818 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[col_dof_index]);
819
823 task_buffer.starting_task_indices_for_dof_pairs_cpu[0] = 0;
824 for (size_type i = 0; i < row_dof_indices.size(); i++)
825 {
826 i_global_dof_index = (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
827 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_indices[i]] :
828 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
829 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[row_dof_indices[i]]);
830
831 task_buffer.starting_task_indices_for_dof_pairs_cpu[i + 1] =
832 task_buffer.starting_task_indices_for_dof_pairs_cpu[i] +
833 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
834 create_sauter_quadrature_tasks_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
835 task_buffer,
836 i_global_dof_index,
837 j_global_dof_index,
838 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
839 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
840 mappings,
841 material_id_to_mapping_index,
842 normal_detector,
843 scratch_data,
844 copy_data);
845 }
846
850 task_buffer.process_tasks(
851 col_vector,
852 kernel,
853 kernel_factor,
854 bem_values_gpu,
855 ConfigAccessor::get_far_field_task_num_per_block(),
856 ConfigAccessor::get_far_field_block_size_for_quad_result_accumulation(),
857 scratch_data.cuda_stream_handle);
858}

977template <int dim,
978 int spacedim,
979 template <int, typename>
980 typename KernelFunctionType,
981 typename RangeNumberType,
982 typename KernelNumberType,
983 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
984size_type
985random_select_ref_row(
986 Vector<RangeNumberType> &row_vector,
987 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
988 &kernel,
989 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
990 std::forward_list<size_type> &remaining_row_indices,
991 const size_type current_ref_row_index,
992 const size_type pass_the_end_ref_row_index,
993 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &row_dof_indices,
994 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &col_dof_indices,
995 const std::vector<
996 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
997 &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
998 const std::vector<
999 std::vector<const typename DoFHandler<dim, spacedim>::cell_iterator *>>
1000 &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
1001 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
1002 dim,
1003 spacedim,
1004 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
1005 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
1006 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
1007 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
1008 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
1009 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
1010 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
1011 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
1012 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
1013 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
1014 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
1015 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
1016 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDAPairCellWiseScratchData<
1017 dim,
1018 spacedim,
1019 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &scratch_data_gpu,
1020 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data)
1021{
1022 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
1023 static_assert(
1024 std::is_same<
1025 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type,
1026 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
1027
1028 AssertDimension(row_vector.size(), col_dof_indices.size());
1029
1034 size_type next_ref_row_selection_index;
1038 size_type next_ref_row_index(row_dof_indices.size());
1043 types::global_dof_index next_ref_row_dof_index;
1044
1045 while (!remaining_row_indices.empty())
1046 {
1047 next_ref_row_selection_index =
1048 generate_random_index(0, size(remaining_row_indices) - 1);
1049 next_ref_row_index =
1050 value_at(remaining_row_indices, next_ref_row_selection_index);
1051 next_ref_row_dof_index = row_dof_indices[next_ref_row_index];
1052
1053 if (next_ref_row_index != current_ref_row_index)
1054 {
1058 assemble_kernel_row(row_vector,
1059 kernel,
1060 kernel_factor,
1061 next_ref_row_dof_index,
1062 col_dof_indices,
1063 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
1064 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
1065 bem_values_gpu,
1066 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
1067 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
1068 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
1069 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
1070 mappings,
1071 material_id_to_mapping_index,
1072 normal_detector,
1073 scratch_data,
1074 scratch_data_gpu,
1075 copy_data);
1076
1077 if (LinAlg::is_all_zero(row_vector))
1078 {
1084 erase_at(remaining_row_indices, next_ref_row_selection_index);
1085
1086 continue;
1087 }
1088 else
1089 {
1094 return next_ref_row_index;
1095 }
1096 }
1097 else
1098 {
1099 if (size(remaining_row_indices) == 1)
1100 {
1106 return pass_the_end_ref_row_index;
1107 }
1108 else
1109 {
1114 continue;
1115 }
1116 }
1117 }
1118
1119 return pass_the_end_ref_row_index;
1120}

2401
2402 if (next_ref_col_index != current_ref_col_index)
2403 {
2404 A.get_column(next_ref_col_index, col_vector);
2405
2406 if (LinAlg::is_all_zero(col_vector))
2407 {
2413 erase_at(remaining_col_indices, next_ref_col_selection_index);
2414 }
2415 else
2416 {
2421 return next_ref_col_index;
2422 }
2423 }
2424 else
2425 {
2426 if (size(remaining_col_indices) == 1)
2427 {
2433 return pass_the_end_ref_col_index;
2434 }
2435 else
2436 {
2442 continue;
2443 }
2444 }
2445 }
2446
2447 return pass_the_end_ref_col_index;
2448}

2479template <int dim,
2480 int spacedim,
2481 template <int, typename>
2482 typename KernelFunctionType,
2483 typename RangeNumberType,
2484 typename KernelNumberType,
2485 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
2486void
2487aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
2488 RkMatrix<RangeNumberType> &rkmat,
2489 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
2490 &aca_config,
2491 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
2492 &kernel,
2493 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
2494 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &row_dof_index_range,
2495 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> &col_dof_index_range,
2496 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
2497 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
2498 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
2499 dim,
2500 spacedim,
2501 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
2502 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
2503 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2504 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
2505 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2506 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2507 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2508 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
2509 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
2510 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
2511 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
2512 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
2513 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDAPairCellWiseScratchData<
2514 dim,
2515 spacedim,
2516 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &scratch_data_gpu,
2517 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data)
2518{
2519 using real_type = typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type;
2520 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
2521 static_assert(
2522 std::is_same<
2523 real_type,
2524 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
2525
2529 const size_type m = row_dof_index_range[1] - row_dof_index_range[0];
2530 const size_type n = col_dof_index_range[1] - col_dof_index_range[0];
2531
2532 AssertDimension(rkmat.get_m(), m);
2533 AssertDimension(rkmat.get_n(), n);
2534
2539 const unsigned int effective_max_iter =
2540 (aca_config.max_iter > std::min(m, n)) ? std::min(m, n) :
2541 aca_config.max_iter;
2542
2547 std::vector<types::global_dof_index> row_dof_indices(m);
2548 std::vector<types::global_dof_index> col_dof_indices(n);
2549 gen_linear_indices<vector_uta, types::global_dof_index>(
2550 row_dof_indices, row_dof_index_range[0]);
2551 gen_linear_indices<vector_uta, types::global_dof_index>(
2552 col_dof_indices, col_dof_index_range[0]);
2553
2560 AssertDimension(rkmat.get_formal_rank(), effective_max_iter);
2561 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> &u_mat = rkmat.get_A();
2562 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> &v_mat = rkmat.get_B();
2563 u_mat = RangeNumberType();
2564 v_mat = RangeNumberType();
2565
2570 std::forward_list<size_type> remaining_row_indices(m);
2571 std::forward_list<size_type> remaining_col_indices(n);
2572
2573 gen_linear_indices<forward_list_uta, size_type>(remaining_row_indices);
2574 gen_linear_indices<forward_list_uta, size_type>(remaining_col_indices);
2575
2580 Vector<RangeNumberType> vr(n);
2581 Vector<RangeNumberType> uc(m);
2582
2583 size_type r = random_select_ref_row(vr,
2584 kernel,
2585 kernel_factor,
2586 remaining_row_indices,
2587 m,
2588 m,
2589 row_dof_indices,
2590 col_dof_indices,
2591 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2592 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2593 bem_values_gpu,
2594 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2595 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2596 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2597 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2598 mappings,
2599 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2600 normal_detector,
2601 scratch_data,
2602 scratch_data_gpu,
2603 copy_data);
2604
2605 if (r == m)
2606 {
2607 // When there is no reference row can be selected, the current matrix
2608 // block is purely zero. Then return a zero rank-k matrix.
2609 rkmat.reinit(m, n, 0);
2610 return;
2611 }
2612
2613 size_type c = random_select_ref_column(uc,
2614 kernel,
2615 kernel_factor,
2616 remaining_col_indices,
2617 n,
2618 n,
2619 row_dof_indices,
2620 col_dof_indices,
2621 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2622 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2623 bem_values_gpu,
2624 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2625 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2626 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2627 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2628 mappings,
2629 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2630 normal_detector,
2631 scratch_data,
2632 scratch_data_gpu,
2633 copy_data);
2634
2635 if (c == n)
2636 {
2637 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the current
2638 // matrix block is purely zero. Then return a zero rank-k matrix.
2639 rkmat.reinit(m, n, 0);
2640 return;
2641 }
2642
2646 Vector<real_type> vr_abs(n);
2647 Vector<real_type> uc_abs(m);
2648
2656 std::transform(vr.begin(),
2657 vr.end(),
2658 vr_abs.begin(),
2659 static_cast<real_type (*)(RangeNumberType)>(std::abs));
2660 std::transform(uc.begin(),
2661 uc.end(),
2662 uc_abs.begin(),
2663 static_cast<real_type (*)(RangeNumberType)>(std::abs));
2664
2669 size_type ik, jk;
2670
2674 Vector<RangeNumberType> vk(n);
2675 Vector<RangeNumberType> uk(m);
2676
2681 Vector<real_type> vk_abs(n);
2682 Vector<real_type> uk_abs(m);
2683
2687 Vector<RangeNumberType> vl(n);
2688 Vector<RangeNumberType> ul(m);
2689
2693 real_type error_threshold = 0.;
2694
2698 for (unsigned int k = 1; k <= effective_max_iter; k++)
2699 {
2703 // N.B. The function @p std::max_element return the iterator pointing
2704 // to the maximum element in the list.
2705 size_type i_star =
2706 std::distance(uc_abs.begin(),
2707 std::max_element(uc_abs.begin(), uc_abs.end()));
2708
2712 size_type j_star =
2713 std::distance(vr_abs.begin(),
2714 std::max_element(vr_abs.begin(), vr_abs.end()));
2715
2716 if (uc_abs(i_star) > vr_abs(j_star))
2717 {
2721 ik = i_star;
2722
2726 assemble_kernel_row(vk,
2727 kernel,
2728 kernel_factor,
2729 row_dof_indices[ik],
2730 col_dof_indices,
2731 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2732 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2733 bem_values_gpu,
2734 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2735 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2736 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2737 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2738 mappings,
2739 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2740 normal_detector,
2741 scratch_data,
2742 scratch_data_gpu,
2743 copy_data);
2744
2753 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
2754 {
2758 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
2759 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
2760
2761 vk.add(-ul(ik), vl);
2762 }
2763
2768 std::transform(vk.begin(),
2769 vk.end(),
2770 vk_abs.begin(),
2771 static_cast<real_type (*)(RangeNumberType)>(std::abs));
2772 jk = std::distance(vk_abs.begin(),
2773 std::max_element(vk_abs.begin(), vk_abs.end()));
2774
2778 RangeNumberType value_at_cross = vk(jk);
2779 vk /= value_at_cross;
2780
2784 assemble_kernel_column(uk,
2785 kernel,
2786 kernel_factor,
2787 row_dof_indices,
2788 col_dof_indices[jk],
2789 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2790 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2791 bem_values_gpu,
2792 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2793 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2794 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2795 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2796 mappings,
2797 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2798 normal_detector,
2799 scratch_data,
2800 scratch_data_gpu,
2801 copy_data);
2802
2803 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
2804 {
2808 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
2809 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
2810
2811 uk.add(-vl(jk), ul);
2812 }
2813 }
2814 else
2815 {
2819 jk = j_star;
2820
2824 assemble_kernel_column(uk,
2825 kernel,
2826 kernel_factor,
2827 row_dof_indices,
2828 col_dof_indices[jk],
2829 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2830 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2831 bem_values_gpu,
2832 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2833 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2834 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2835 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2836 mappings,
2837 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2838 normal_detector,
2839 scratch_data,
2840 scratch_data_gpu,
2841 copy_data);
2842
2843 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
2844 {
2848 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
2849 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
2850
2851 uk.add(-vl(jk), ul);
2852 }
2853
2858 std::transform(uk.begin(),
2859 uk.end(),
2860 uk_abs.begin(),
2861 static_cast<real_type (*)(RangeNumberType)>(std::abs));
2862 ik = std::distance(uk_abs.begin(),
2863 std::max_element(uk_abs.begin(), uk_abs.end()));
2864
2868 assemble_kernel_row(vk,
2869 kernel,
2870 kernel_factor,
2871 row_dof_indices[ik],
2872 col_dof_indices,
2873 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2874 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2875 bem_values_gpu,
2876 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2877 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2878 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2879 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2880 mappings,
2881 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2882 normal_detector,
2883 scratch_data,
2884 scratch_data_gpu,
2885 copy_data);
2886
2887 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
2888 {
2892 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
2893 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
2894
2895 vk.add(-ul(ik), vl);
2896 }
2897
2901 RangeNumberType value_at_cross = vk(jk);
2902 vk /= value_at_cross;
2903 }
2904
2909 u_mat.fill_col(k - 1, uk, false);
2910 v_mat.fill_col(k - 1, vk, false);
2911
2912 if (k == 1)
2913 {
2917 error_threshold = aca_config.epsilon * rkmat.frobenius_norm(1);
2918 }
2919
2920 remaining_row_indices.remove(ik);
2921 remaining_col_indices.remove(jk);
2922
2923 if (ik == r)
2924 {
2929 r = random_select_ref_row(vr,
2930 kernel,
2931 kernel_factor,
2932 remaining_row_indices,
2933 r,
2934 m,
2935 row_dof_indices,
2936 col_dof_indices,
2937 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2938 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
2939 bem_values_gpu,
2940 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2941 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
2942 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
2943 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
2944 mappings,
2945 material_id_to_mapping_index,
2946 normal_detector,
2947 scratch_data,
2948 scratch_data_gpu,
2949 copy_data);
2950
2951 if (r == m)
2952 {
2953 // When there is no reference row can be selected, the ACA+
2954 // iteration should stop here.
2955 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
2956 {
2963 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
2964 }
2965
2971 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
2972 v_mat.conjugate();
2973
2974 return;
2975 }
2976 else
2977 {
2978 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
2979 {
2983 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
2984 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
2985
2986 vr.add(-ul(r), vl);
2987 }
2988 }
2989 }
2990 else
2991 {
2995 vr.add(-uk(r), vk);
2996 }
2997
3001 std::transform(vr.begin(),
3002 vr.end(),
3003 vr_abs.begin(),
3004 static_cast<real_type (*)(RangeNumberType)>(std::abs));
3005
3006 if (jk == c)
3007 {
3012 c = random_select_ref_column(uc,
3013 kernel,
3014 kernel_factor,
3015 remaining_col_indices,
3016 c,
3017 n,
3018 row_dof_indices,
3019 col_dof_indices,
3020 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
3021 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
3022 bem_values_gpu,
3023 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
3024 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
3025 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
3026 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
3027 mappings,
3028 material_id_to_mapping_index,
3029 normal_detector,
3030 scratch_data,
3031 scratch_data_gpu,
3032 copy_data);
3033
3034 if (c == n)
3035 {
3036 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the ACA+
3037 // iteration should stop here.
3038 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
3039 {
3046 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
3047 }
3048
3054 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
3055 v_mat.conjugate();
3056
3057 return;
3058 }
3059 else
3060 {
3061 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
3062 {
3066 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
3067 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
3068
3069 uc.add(-vl(c), ul);
3070 }
3071 }
3072 }
3073 else
3074 {
3078 uc.add(-vk(c), uk);
3079 }
3080
3084 std::transform(uc.begin(),
3085 uc.end(),
3086 uc_abs.begin(),
3087 static_cast<real_type (*)(RangeNumberType)>(std::abs));
3088
3092 if ((k > 1) && (uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm() <= error_threshold))
3093 {
3094 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
3095 {
3101 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
3102 }
3103
3109 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
3110 v_mat.conjugate();
3111
3112 return;
3113 }
3114 else
3115 {
3116 if (size(remaining_row_indices) == 0)
3117 {
3118 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
3119 {
3126 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
3127 }
3128
3134 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
3135 v_mat.conjugate();
3136
3137 return;
3138 }
3139 }
3140 }
3141
3147 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
3148 v_mat.conjugate();
3149
3150 std::cerr
3151 << "Maximum H-matrix rank has been reached and the approximation accuracy has not been achieved, exit early!"
3152 << std::endl;
3153}

3402 Vector<RangeNumberType> ul(m);

3522 {
3526 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);

3757 scratch_data_gpu,

3760 if (c == n)
3761 {
3762 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the ACA+

3765 {
3772 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
3773 }
3774
3780 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
3781 v_mat.conjugate();
3782
3783 return;
3784 }
3785 else
3786 {
3787 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
3788 {
3792 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);

3795 uc.add(-vl(c), ul);

3797 }
3798 }

3800 {
3804 uc.add(-vk(c), uk);

3827 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
3828 }
3829
3835 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
3836 v_mat.conjugate();
3837
3838 return;
3839 }
3840 else

3842 if (size(remaining_row_indices) == 0)

4294 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4295 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
4296 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
4297 mappings,
4298 material_id_to_mapping_index,
4299 normal_detector,
4300 scratch_data,
4301 copy_data);
4302
4303 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
4304 {
4308 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
4309 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
4310
4311 uk.add(-vl(jk), ul);
4312 }
4313
4318 std::transform(uk.begin(),
4319 uk.end(),
4320 uk_abs.begin(),
4321 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
4322 return std::abs(val);
4323 });
4324 ik = std::distance(uk_abs.begin(),
4325 std::max_element(uk_abs.begin(), uk_abs.end()));
4326
4330 assemble_kernel_row(sauter_task_buffer_for_row_vector,
4331 vk,
4332 kernel,
4333 kernel_factor,
4334 row_dof_indices[ik],
4335 col_dof_indices,
4336 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
4337 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
4338 bem_values_gpu,
4339 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4340 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4341 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
4342 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
4343 mappings,
4344 material_id_to_mapping_index,
4345 normal_detector,
4346 scratch_data,
4347 copy_data);
4348
4349 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
4350 {
4354 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
4355 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
4356
4357 vk.add(-ul(ik), vl);
4358 }
4359
4363 RangeNumberType value_at_cross = vk(jk);
4364 vk /= value_at_cross;
4365 }
4366
4371 u_mat.fill_col(k - 1, uk, false);
4372 v_mat.fill_col(k - 1, vk, false);
4373
4374 if (k == 1)
4375 {
4379 error_threshold = aca_config.epsilon * rkmat.frobenius_norm(1);
4380 }
4381
4382 remaining_row_indices.remove(ik);
4383 remaining_col_indices.remove(jk);
4384
4385 if (ik == r)
4386 {
4391 r = random_select_ref_row(sauter_task_buffer_for_row_vector,
4392 vr,
4393 kernel,
4394 kernel_factor,
4395 remaining_row_indices,
4396 r,
4397 m,
4398 row_dof_indices,
4399 col_dof_indices,
4400 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
4401 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
4402 bem_values_gpu,
4403 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4404 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4405 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
4406 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
4407 mappings,
4408 material_id_to_mapping_index,
4409 normal_detector,
4410 scratch_data,
4411 copy_data);
4412
4413 if (r == m)
4414 {
4415 // When there is no reference row can be selected, the ACA+
4416 // iteration should stop here.
4417 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
4418 {
4425 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
4426 }
4427
4428 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
4429 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
4430 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
4431 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
4432
4438 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
4439 v_mat.conjugate();
4440
4441 return;
4442 }
4443 else
4444 {
4445 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
4446 {
4450 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
4451 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
4452
4453 vr.add(-ul(r), vl);
4454 }
4455 }
4456 }
4457 else
4458 {
4462 vr.add(-uk(r), vk);
4463 }
4464
4468 std::transform(vr.begin(),
4469 vr.end(),
4470 vr_abs.begin(),
4471 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
4472 return std::abs(val);
4473 });
4474
4475 if (jk == c)
4476 {
4481 c = random_select_ref_column(sauter_task_buffer_for_col_vector,
4482 uc,
4483 kernel,
4484 kernel_factor,
4485 remaining_col_indices,
4486 c,
4487 n,
4488 row_dof_indices,
4489 col_dof_indices,
4490 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
4491 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
4492 bem_values_gpu,
4493 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4494 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
4495 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
4496 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
4497 mappings,
4498 material_id_to_mapping_index,
4499 normal_detector,
4500 scratch_data,
4501 copy_data);
4502
4503 if (c == n)
4504 {
4505 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the ACA+
4506 // iteration should stop here.
4507 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
4508 {
4515 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
4516 }
4517
4518 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
4519 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
4520 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
4521 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
4522
4528 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
4529 v_mat.conjugate();
4530
4531 return;
4532 }
4533 else
4534 {
4535 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
4536 {
4540 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
4541 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
4542
4543 uc.add(-vl(c), ul);
4544 }
4545 }
4546 }
4547 else
4548 {
4552 uc.add(-vk(c), uk);
4553 }
4554
4558 std::transform(uc.begin(),
4559 uc.end(),
4560 uc_abs.begin(),
4561 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
4562 return std::abs(val);
4563 });
4564
4568 if ((k > 1) && (uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm() <= error_threshold))
4569 {
4570 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
4571 {
4577 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
4578 }
4579
4580 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
4581 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
4582 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
4583 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
4584
4590 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
4591 v_mat.conjugate();
4592
4593 return;
4594 }
4595 else
4596 {
4597 if (size(remaining_row_indices) == 0)
4598 {
4599 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
4600 {
4607 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
4608 }
4609
4610 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
4611 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
4612 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
4613 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
4614
4620 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
4621 v_mat.conjugate();
4622
4623 return;
4624 }
4625 }
4626 }
4627
4628 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
4629 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
4630 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
4631 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
4632
4638 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
4639 v_mat.conjugate();
4640
4641 std::cerr
4642 << "Maximum H-matrix rank has been reached and the approximation accuracy has not been achieved, exit early!"
4643 << std::endl;
4644}

4993 std::transform(vk.begin(),

5037 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);

5097

5121
5122 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)

5175 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
5176 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
5177 bem_values_gpu,
5178 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
5179 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
5180 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
5181 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
5182 mappings,
5183 material_id_to_mapping_index,
5184 normal_detector,
5185 scratch_data,
5186 copy_data);
5187
5188 if (r == m)
5189 {
5190 // When there is no reference row can be selected, the ACA+
5191 // iteration should stop here.
5192 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5193 {
5200 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5201 }
5202
5203 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
5204 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
5205 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
5206 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
5207
5213 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
5214 v_mat.conjugate();
5215
5216 return;
5217 }
5218 else
5219 {
5220 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
5221 {
5225 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5226 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5227
5228 vr.add(-ul(r), vl);
5229 }
5230 }
5231 }
5232 else
5233 {
5237 vr.add(-uk(r), vk);
5238 }
5239
5243 std::transform(vr.begin(),
5244 vr.end(),
5245 vr_abs.begin(),
5246 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5247 return std::abs(val);
5248 });
5249
5250 if (jk == c)
5251 {
5256 c = random_select_ref_column(sauter_task_buffer_for_col_vector,
5257 uc,
5258 kernel,
5259 kernel_factor,
5260 mass_vmult_weq,
5261 stabilization_factor,
5262 remaining_col_indices,
5263 c,
5264 n,
5265 row_dof_indices,
5266 col_dof_indices,
5267 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
5268 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
5269 bem_values_gpu,
5270 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
5271 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
5272 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
5273 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
5274 mappings,
5275 material_id_to_mapping_index,
5276 normal_detector,
5277 scratch_data,
5278 copy_data);
5279
5280 if (c == n)
5281 {
5282 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the ACA+
5283 // iteration should stop here.
5284 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5285 {
5292 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5293 }
5294
5295 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
5296 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
5297 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
5298 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
5299
5305 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
5306 v_mat.conjugate();
5307
5308 return;
5309 }
5310 else
5311 {
5312 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
5313 {
5317 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5318 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5319
5320 uc.add(-vl(c), ul);
5321 }
5322 }
5323 }
5324 else
5325 {
5329 uc.add(-vk(c), uk);
5330 }
5331
5335 std::transform(uc.begin(),
5336 uc.end(),
5337 uc_abs.begin(),
5338 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5339 return std::abs(val);
5340 });
5341
5345 if ((k > 1) && (uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm() <= error_threshold))
5346 {
5347 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5348 {
5354 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5355 }
5356
5357 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
5358 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
5359 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
5360 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
5361
5367 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
5368 v_mat.conjugate();
5369
5370 return;
5371 }
5372 else
5373 {
5374 if (size(remaining_row_indices) == 0)
5375 {
5376 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5377 {
5384 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5385 }
5386
5387 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
5388 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
5389 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
5390 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
5391
5397 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
5398 v_mat.conjugate();
5399
5400 return;
5401 }
5402 }
5403 }
5404
5405 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vr.data())));
5406 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uc.data())));
5407 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(vk.data())));
5408 AssertCuda(cudaHostUnregister((void *)(uk.data())));
5409
5415 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::is_complex)
5416 v_mat.conjugate();
5417
5418 std::cerr
5419 << "Maximum H-matrix rank has been reached and the approximation accuracy has not been achieved, exit early!"
5420 << std::endl;
5421}

5423
5437template <typename RangeNumberType = double>
5438void
5439aca_plus(
5440 RkMatrix<RangeNumberType> &rkmat,
5441 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
5442 &aca_config,
5443 const LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> &A)
5444{
5445 using real_type = typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type;
5446
5447 AssertDimension(rkmat.get_m(), A.m());
5448 AssertDimension(rkmat.get_n(), A.n());
5449
5453 const size_type m = A.m();
5454 const size_type n = A.n();
5455
5462 AssertDimension(rkmat.get_formal_rank(), aca_config.max_iter);
5463 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> &u_mat = rkmat.get_A();
5464 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> &v_mat = rkmat.get_B();
5465 u_mat = RangeNumberType();
5466 v_mat = RangeNumberType();
5467
5472 std::forward_list<size_type> remaining_row_indices(m);
5473 std::forward_list<size_type> remaining_col_indices(n);
5474
5475 gen_linear_indices<forward_list_uta, size_type>(remaining_row_indices);
5476 gen_linear_indices<forward_list_uta, size_type>(remaining_col_indices);
5477
5482 Vector<RangeNumberType> vr(n);
5483 Vector<RangeNumberType> uc(m);
5484
5485 size_type r = random_select_ref_row(vr, A, remaining_row_indices, m, m);
5486
5487 if (r == m)
5488 {
5489 // When there is no reference row can be selected, the current matrix
5490 // block is purely zero. Then return a zero rank-k matrix.
5491 rkmat.reinit(m, n, 0);
5492 return;
5493 }
5494
5495 size_type c = random_select_ref_column(uc, A, remaining_col_indices, n, n);
5496
5497 if (c == n)
5498 {
5499 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the current
5500 // matrix block is purely zero. Then return a zero rank-k matrix.
5501 rkmat.reinit(m, n, 0);
5502 return;
5503 }
5504
5508 Vector<real_type> vr_abs(n);
5509 Vector<real_type> uc_abs(m);
5510
5518 std::transform(vr.begin(),
5519 vr.end(),
5520 vr_abs.begin(),
5521 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5522 return std::abs(val);
5523 });
5524 std::transform(uc.begin(),
5525 uc.end(),
5526 uc_abs.begin(),
5527 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5528 return std::abs(val);
5529 });
5530
5535 size_type ik, jk;
5536
5540 Vector<RangeNumberType> vk(n);
5541 Vector<RangeNumberType> uk(m);
5542
5547 Vector<real_type> vk_abs(n);
5548 Vector<real_type> uk_abs(m);
5549
5553 Vector<RangeNumberType> vl(n);
5554 Vector<RangeNumberType> ul(m);
5555
5559 for (unsigned int k = 1; k <= aca_config.max_iter; k++)
5560 {
5564 // N.B. The function @p std::max_element return the iterator pointing
5565 // to the maximum element in the list.
5566 size_type i_star =
5567 std::distance(uc_abs.begin(),
5568 std::max_element(uc_abs.begin(), uc_abs.end()));
5569
5573 size_type j_star =
5574 std::distance(vr_abs.begin(),
5575 std::max_element(vr_abs.begin(), vr_abs.end()));
5576
5577 if (uc_abs(i_star) > vr_abs(j_star))
5578 {
5582 ik = i_star;
5583
5587 A.get_row(ik, vk);
5588
5597 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
5598 {
5602 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5603 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5604
5605 vk.add(-ul(ik), vl);
5606 }
5607
5612 std::transform(vk.begin(),
5613 vk.end(),
5614 vk_abs.begin(),
5615 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5616 return std::abs(val);
5617 });
5618 jk = std::distance(vk_abs.begin(),
5619 std::max_element(vk_abs.begin(), vk_abs.end()));
5620
5624 RangeNumberType value_at_cross = vk(jk);
5625 vk /= value_at_cross;
5626
5630 A.get_column(jk, uk);
5631
5632 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
5633 {
5637 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5638 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5639
5640 uk.add(-vl(jk), ul);
5641 }
5642 }
5643 else
5644 {
5648 jk = j_star;
5649
5653 A.get_column(jk, uk);
5654
5655 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
5656 {
5660 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5661 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5662
5663 uk.add(-vl(jk), ul);
5664 }
5665
5670 std::transform(uk.begin(),
5671 uk.end(),
5672 uk_abs.begin(),
5673 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5674 return std::abs(val);
5675 });
5676 ik = std::distance(uk_abs.begin(),
5677 std::max_element(uk_abs.begin(), uk_abs.end()));
5678
5682 A.get_row(ik, vk);
5683
5684 for (size_type l = 1; l < k; l++)
5685 {
5689 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5690 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5691
5692 vk.add(-ul(ik), vl);
5693 }
5694
5698 RangeNumberType value_at_cross = vk(jk);
5699 vk /= value_at_cross;
5700 }
5701
5706 u_mat.fill_col(k - 1, uk, false);
5707 v_mat.fill_col(k - 1, vk, false);
5708
5709 remaining_row_indices.remove(ik);
5710 remaining_col_indices.remove(jk);
5711
5712 if (ik == r)
5713 {
5718 r = random_select_ref_row(vr, A, remaining_row_indices, r, m);
5719
5720 if (r == m)
5721 {
5722 // When there is no reference row can be selected, the ACA+
5723 // iteration should stop here.
5724 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5725 {
5732 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5733 }
5734
5740 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::is_complex)
5741 v_mat.conjugate();
5742
5743 return;
5744 }
5745 else
5746 {
5747 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
5748 {
5752 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5753 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5754
5755 vr.add(-ul(r), vl);
5756 }
5757 }
5758 }
5759 else
5760 {
5764 vr.add(-uk(r), vk);
5765 }
5766
5770 std::transform(vr.begin(),
5771 vr.end(),
5772 vr_abs.begin(),
5773 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5774 return std::abs(val);
5775 });
5776
5777 if (jk == c)
5778 {
5783 c = random_select_ref_column(uc, A, remaining_col_indices, c, n);
5784
5785 if (c == n)
5786 {
5787 // When there is no reference column can be selected, the ACA+
5788 // iteration should stop here.
5789 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5790 {
5797 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5798 }
5799
5805 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::is_complex)
5806 v_mat.conjugate();
5807
5808 return;
5809 }
5810 else
5811 {
5812 for (unsigned int l = 1; l <= k; l++)
5813 {
5817 u_mat.get_column(l - 1, ul);
5818 v_mat.get_column(l - 1, vl);
5819
5820 uc.add(-vl(c), ul);
5821 }
5822 }
5823 }
5824 else
5825 {
5829 uc.add(-vk(c), uk);
5830 }
5831
5835 std::transform(uc.begin(),
5836 uc.end(),
5837 uc_abs.begin(),
5838 [](const RangeNumberType &val) -> real_type {
5839 return std::abs(val);
5840 });
5841
5845 real_type error_threshold = 0.;
5846 // DEBUG
5847 if (k > 1)
5848 {
5849 if (aca_config.eta >= 1.0)
5850 {
5851 error_threshold = aca_config.epsilon * rkmat.frobenius_norm(1);
5852 }
5853 else
5854 {
5855 error_threshold = aca_config.epsilon * (1.0 - aca_config.eta) /
5856 (1.0 + aca_config.epsilon) *
5857 rkmat.frobenius_norm(k - 1);
5858 }
5859
5860 deallog << "uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm(): "
5861 << uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm() << "\n"
5862 << "error_threshold: " << error_threshold << std::endl;
5863 }
5864 else
5865 {
5866 deallog << "uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm(): "
5867 << uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm() << std::endl;
5868 }
5869
5870 if ((k > 1) && (uk.l2_norm() * vk.l2_norm() <= error_threshold))
5871 {
5872 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5873 {
5879 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5880 // DEBUG
5881 deallog << "Early successful return from ACA+!" << std::endl;
5882 }
5883
5889 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::is_complex)
5890 v_mat.conjugate();
5891
5892 return;
5893 }
5894 else
5895 {
5896 if (size(remaining_row_indices) == 0)
5897 {
5898 if (k < aca_config.max_iter)
5899 {
5906 rkmat.keep_first_n_columns(k);
5907 }
5908
5914 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::is_complex)
5915 v_mat.conjugate();
5916
5917 return;
5918 }
5919 }
5920 }
5921
5927 if constexpr (numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::is_complex)
5928 v_mat.conjugate();
5929
5930 std::cerr
5931 << "Maximum H-matrix rank has been reached and the approximation accuracy has not been achieved, exit early!"
5932 << std::endl;
5933}

5935
5980template <int dim,
5981 int spacedim,
5982 template <int, typename>
5983 typename KernelFunctionType,
5984 typename RangeNumberType,
5985 typename KernelNumberType,
5986 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
5987void
5988fill_hmatrix_leaf_node_with_aca_plus(
5989 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *leaf_mat,
5990 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
5991 &aca_config,
5992 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
5993 &kernel,
5994 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
5995 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
5996 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
5997 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
5998 dim,
5999 spacedim,
6000 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
6001 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_handler,
6002 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_handler,
6003 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
6004 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6005 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
6006 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6007 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
6008 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
6009 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
6010 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
6011 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
6012 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
6013 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
6014 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDAPairCellWiseScratchData<
6015 dim,
6016 spacedim,
6017 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &scratch_data_gpu,
6018 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data,
6019 const bool enable_build_symmetric_hmat = false)
6020{
6021 using real_type = typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type;
6022 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
6023 static_assert(
6024 std::is_same<
6025 real_type,
6026 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
6027
6028#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
6029 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_hmat_node");
6030#endif
6031
6035 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> *row_index_range =
6036 leaf_mat->get_row_index_range();
6037 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> *col_index_range =
6038 leaf_mat->get_col_index_range();
6039
6044 types::global_dof_index i_global_dof_index;
6045 types::global_dof_index j_global_dof_index;
6046
6047 switch (leaf_mat->get_type())
6048 {
6049 case FullMatrixType: {
6050 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> *fullmat =
6051 leaf_mat->get_fullmatrix();
6052
6053 if (enable_build_symmetric_hmat && kernel.is_symmetric())
6054 {
6060 switch (leaf_mat->get_block_type())
6061 {
6062 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
6067 Assert(leaf_mat->get_property() ==
6068 HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric,
6069 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(
6070 leaf_mat->get_property()));
6071 Assert(fullmat->get_property() ==
6072 LAPACKSupport::Property::symmetric,
6073 ExcInvalidLAPACKFullMatrixProperty(
6074 fullmat->get_property()));
6075
6080 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
6081 {
6082 i_global_dof_index =
6083 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6084 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i] :
6085 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6086 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] +
6087 i]);
6088
6089 for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; j++)
6090 {
6091 j_global_dof_index =
6092 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices ==
6093 nullptr) ?
6094 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6095 j] :
6096 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6097 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6098 j]);
6099
6100 (*fullmat)(i, j) =
6101 sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
6102 kernel,
6103 kernel_factor,
6104 i_global_dof_index,
6105 j_global_dof_index,
6106 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6107 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6108 bem_values_gpu,
6109 mappings,
6110 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6111 normal_detector,
6112 scratch_data,
6113 scratch_data_gpu,
6114 copy_data);
6115 }
6116 }
6117
6118 break;
6119 }
6120 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
6126 break;
6127 }
6128 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
6134 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
6135 {
6136 i_global_dof_index =
6137 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6138 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i] :
6139 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6140 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] +
6141 i]);
6142
6143 for (size_t j = 0; j < fullmat->n(); j++)
6144 {
6145 j_global_dof_index =
6146 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices ==
6147 nullptr) ?
6148 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6149 j] :
6150 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6151 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6152 j]);
6153
6154 (*fullmat)(i, j) =
6155 sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
6156 kernel,
6157 kernel_factor,
6158 i_global_dof_index,
6159 j_global_dof_index,
6160 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6161 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6162 bem_values_gpu,
6163 mappings,
6164 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6165 normal_detector,
6166 scratch_data,
6167 scratch_data_gpu,
6168 copy_data);
6169 }
6170 }
6171
6172 break;
6173 }
6174 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::undefined_block: {
6175 Assert(false,
6176 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
6177 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
6178
6179 break;
6180 }
6181 }
6182 }
6183 else
6184 {
6188 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
6189 {
6190 i_global_dof_index =
6191 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6192 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i] :
6193 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6194 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i]);
6195
6196 for (size_t j = 0; j < fullmat->n(); j++)
6197 {
6198 j_global_dof_index =
6199 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6200 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] + j] :
6201 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6202 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] + j]);
6203
6204 (*fullmat)(i, j) = sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
6205 kernel,
6206 kernel_factor,
6207 i_global_dof_index,
6208 j_global_dof_index,
6209 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6210 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6211 bem_values_gpu,
6212 mappings,
6213 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6214 normal_detector,
6215 scratch_data,
6216 scratch_data_gpu,
6217 copy_data);
6218 }
6219 }
6220 }
6221
6222 break;
6223 }
6224 case RkMatrixType: {
6233 RkMatrix<RangeNumberType> *rkmat = leaf_mat->get_rkmatrix();
6234
6235 if (enable_build_symmetric_hmat && kernel.is_symmetric())
6236 {
6237 switch (leaf_mat->get_block_type())
6238 {
6239 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
6244 aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
6245 (*rkmat),
6246 aca_config,
6247 kernel,
6248 kernel_factor,
6249 *row_index_range,
6250 *col_index_range,
6251 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
6252 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
6253 bem_values_gpu,
6254 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6255 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6256 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
6257 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
6258 mappings,
6259 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6260 normal_detector,
6261 scratch_data,
6262 scratch_data_gpu,
6263 copy_data);
6264
6265 break;
6266 }
6267 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
6273 break;
6274 }
6275 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
6279 Assert(false,
6280 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
6281 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
6282
6283 break;
6284 }
6285 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::undefined_block: {
6286 Assert(false,
6287 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
6288 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
6289
6290 break;
6291 }
6292 }
6293 }
6294 else
6295 {
6296 aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
6297 (*rkmat),
6298 aca_config,
6299 kernel,
6300 kernel_factor,
6301 (*row_index_range),
6302 (*col_index_range),
6303 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
6304 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
6305 bem_values_gpu,
6306 kx_dof_handler,
6307 ky_dof_handler,
6308 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6309 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6310 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
6311 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
6312 mappings,
6313 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6314 normal_detector,
6315 scratch_data,
6316 scratch_data_gpu,
6317 copy_data);
6318 }
6319
6320 break;
6321 }
6322 default: {
6323 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(leaf_mat->get_type()));
6324 break;
6325 }
6326 }
6327}

6398template <int dim,
6399 int spacedim,
6400 template <int, typename>
6401 typename KernelFunctionType,
6402 typename RangeNumberType,
6403 typename KernelNumberType,
6404 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
6405void
6406fill_hmatrix_leaf_node_with_aca_plus(
6407 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *leaf_mat,
6408 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
6409 &aca_config,
6410 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
6411 &kernel,
6412 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
6413 const std::vector<Vector<KernelNumberType>> &mass_vmult_weq,
6414 const KernelNumberType stabilization_factor,
6415 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
6416 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
6417 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
6418 dim,
6419 spacedim,
6420 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
6421 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_handler,
6422 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_handler,
6423 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
6424 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6425 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
6426 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6427 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
6428 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
6429 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
6430 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
6431 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
6432 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
6433 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &scratch_data,
6434 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDAPairCellWiseScratchData<
6435 dim,
6436 spacedim,
6437 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>> &scratch_data_gpu,
6438 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> &copy_data,
6439 const bool enable_build_symmetric_hmat = false)
6440{
6441 using real_type = typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type;
6442 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
6443 static_assert(
6444 std::is_same<
6445 real_type,
6446 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
6447
6448#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
6449 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_hmat_node_stab");
6450#endif
6451
6452 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> *row_index_range =
6453 leaf_mat->get_row_index_range();
6454 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> *col_index_range =
6455 leaf_mat->get_col_index_range();
6456
6457 types::global_dof_index i_global_dof_index;
6458 types::global_dof_index j_global_dof_index;
6459
6460 switch (leaf_mat->get_type())
6461 {
6462 case FullMatrixType: {
6463 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> *fullmat =
6464 leaf_mat->get_fullmatrix();
6465
6466 if (enable_build_symmetric_hmat && kernel.is_symmetric())
6467 {
6473 switch (leaf_mat->get_block_type())
6474 {
6475 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
6480 Assert(leaf_mat->get_property() ==
6481 HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric,
6482 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(
6483 leaf_mat->get_property()));
6484 Assert(fullmat->get_property() ==
6485 LAPACKSupport::Property::symmetric,
6486 ExcInvalidLAPACKFullMatrixProperty(
6487 fullmat->get_property()));
6488
6493 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
6494 {
6495 i_global_dof_index =
6496 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6497 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i] :
6498 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6499 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] +
6500 i]);
6501
6502 for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; j++)
6503 {
6504 j_global_dof_index =
6505 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices ==
6506 nullptr) ?
6507 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6508 j] :
6509 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6510 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6511 j]);
6512
6513 (*fullmat)(i, j) =
6514 sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
6515 kernel,
6516 kernel_factor,
6517 i_global_dof_index,
6518 j_global_dof_index,
6519 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6520 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6521 bem_values_gpu,
6522 mappings,
6523 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6524 normal_detector,
6525 scratch_data,
6526 scratch_data_gpu,
6527 copy_data);
6528
6529 // N.B. The internal and local DoF indices are
6530 // used directly to access the result vector
6531 // of \f$M w_{\rm eq}\f$.
6532 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
6533 (*fullmat)(i, j) +=
6534 stabilization_factor *
6535 vec((*row_index_range)[0] + i) *
6536 vec((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
6537 }
6538 }
6539
6540 break;
6541 }
6542 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
6548 break;
6549 }
6550 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
6556 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
6557 {
6558 i_global_dof_index =
6559 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6560 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i] :
6561 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6562 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] +
6563 i]);
6564
6565 for (size_t j = 0; j < fullmat->n(); j++)
6566 {
6567 j_global_dof_index =
6568 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices ==
6569 nullptr) ?
6570 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6571 j] :
6572 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6573 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] +
6574 j]);
6575
6576 (*fullmat)(i, j) =
6577 sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
6578 kernel,
6579 kernel_factor,
6580 i_global_dof_index,
6581 j_global_dof_index,
6582 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6583 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6584 bem_values_gpu,
6585 mappings,
6586 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6587 normal_detector,
6588 scratch_data,
6589 scratch_data_gpu,
6590 copy_data);
6591
6592 // N.B. The internal and local DoF indices are
6593 // used directly to access the result vector
6594 // of \f$M w_{\rm eq}\f$.
6595 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
6596 (*fullmat)(i, j) +=
6597 stabilization_factor *
6598 vec((*row_index_range)[0] + i) *
6599 vec((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
6600 }
6601 }
6602
6603 break;
6604 }
6605 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::undefined_block: {
6606 Assert(false,
6607 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
6608 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
6609
6610 break;
6611 }
6612 }
6613 }
6614 else
6615 {
6619 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
6620 {
6621 i_global_dof_index =
6622 (kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6623 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i] :
6624 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6625 kx_dof_i2e_numbering[(*row_index_range)[0] + i]);
6626
6627 for (size_t j = 0; j < fullmat->n(); j++)
6628 {
6629 j_global_dof_index =
6630 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
6631 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] + j] :
6632 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
6633 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] + j]);
6634
6635 (*fullmat)(i, j) = sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
6636 kernel,
6637 kernel_factor,
6638 i_global_dof_index,
6639 j_global_dof_index,
6640 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6641 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
6642 bem_values_gpu,
6643 mappings,
6644 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6645 normal_detector,
6646 scratch_data,
6647 scratch_data_gpu,
6648 copy_data);
6649
6650 // N.B. The internal and local DoF indices are
6651 // used directly to access the result vector of
6652 // \f$M w_{\rm eq}\f$.
6653 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
6654 (*fullmat)(i, j) += stabilization_factor *
6655 vec((*row_index_range)[0] + i) *
6656 vec((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
6657 }
6658 }
6659 }
6660
6661 break;
6662 }
6663 case RkMatrixType: {
6672 RkMatrix<RangeNumberType> *rkmat = leaf_mat->get_rkmatrix();
6673
6674 if (enable_build_symmetric_hmat && kernel.is_symmetric())
6675 {
6676 switch (leaf_mat->get_block_type())
6677 {
6678 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
6683 aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
6684 (*rkmat),
6685 aca_config,
6686 kernel,
6687 kernel_factor,
6688 mass_vmult_weq,
6689 stabilization_factor,
6690 *row_index_range,
6691 *col_index_range,
6692 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
6693 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
6694 bem_values_gpu,
6695 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6696 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6697 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
6698 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
6699 mappings,
6700 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6701 normal_detector,
6702 scratch_data,
6703 scratch_data_gpu,
6704 copy_data);
6705
6706 break;
6707 }
6708 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
6714 break;
6715 }
6716 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block:
6720 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::undefined_block: {
6721 Assert(false,
6722 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
6723 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
6724
6725 break;
6726 }
6727 }
6728 }
6729 else
6730 {
6731 aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
6732 (*rkmat),
6733 aca_config,
6734 kernel,
6735 kernel_factor,
6736 mass_vmult_weq,
6737 stabilization_factor,
6738 (*row_index_range),
6739 (*col_index_range),
6740 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
6741 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
6742 bem_values_gpu,
6743 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6744 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
6745 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
6746 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
6747 mappings,
6748 material_id_to_mapping_index,
6749 normal_detector,
6750 scratch_data,
6751 scratch_data_gpu,
6752 copy_data);
6753 }
6754
6755 break;
6756 }
6757 default: {
6758 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(leaf_mat->get_type()));
6759 break;
6760 }
6761 }
6762}

7029 j_global_dof_index =
7030 (ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices == nullptr) ?
7031 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] + j] :
7032 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices->at(
7033 ky_dof_i2e_numbering[(*col_index_range)[0] + j]);
7034
7035 (*fullmat)(i, j) = sauter_quadrature_on_one_pair_of_dofs(
7036 kernel,
7037 kernel_factor,
7038 mass_matrix_factor,
7039 i_global_dof_index,
7040 j_global_dof_index,
7041 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
7042 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
7043 bem_values_gpu,
7044 mappings,
7045 material_id_to_mapping_index,
7046 normal_detector,
7047 mass_matrix_scratch_data,
7048 scratch_data,
7049 scratch_data_gpu,
7050 copy_data);
7051 }
7052 }
7053 }
7054
7055 break;
7056 }
7057 case RkMatrixType: {
7058 RkMatrix<RangeNumberType> *rkmat = leaf_mat->get_rkmatrix();
7059
7060 if (enable_build_symmetric_hmat && kernel.is_symmetric())
7061 {
7062 switch (leaf_mat->get_block_type())
7063 {
7064 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
7069 aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
7070 (*rkmat),
7071 aca_config,
7072 kernel,
7073 kernel_factor,
7074 *row_index_range,
7075 *col_index_range,
7076 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
7077 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
7078 bem_values_gpu,
7079 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7080 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7081 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
7082 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
7083 mappings,
7084 material_id_to_mapping_index,
7085 normal_detector,
7086 scratch_data,
7087 scratch_data_gpu,
7088 copy_data);
7089
7090 break;
7091 }
7092 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
7098 break;
7099 }
7100 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block:
7104 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::undefined_block: {
7105 Assert(false,
7106 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
7107 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
7108
7109 break;
7110 }
7111 }
7112 }
7113 else
7114 {
7115 aca_plus_parallel_sauter_quad_for_vector_entry(
7116 (*rkmat),
7117 aca_config,
7118 kernel,
7119 kernel_factor,
7120 *row_index_range,
7121 *col_index_range,
7122 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
7123 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
7124 bem_values_gpu,
7125 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7126 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7127 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
7128 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
7129 mappings,
7130 material_id_to_mapping_index,
7131 normal_detector,
7132 scratch_data,
7133 scratch_data_gpu,
7134 copy_data);
7135 }
7136
7137 break;
7138 }
7139 default: {
7140 Assert(false, ExcInvalidHMatrixType(leaf_mat->get_type()));
7141 break;
7142 }
7143 }
7144}

7270

7277
7278 break;

7288 kernel_factor,

7509fill_far_field_hmatrix_leaf_node_subrange_with_aca_plus(
7510 const tbb::blocked_range<
7511 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator>
7512 &range,
7513 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
7514 &aca_config,
7515 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
7516 &kernel,
7517 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
7518 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,

7523 &bem_values,
7524 const HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<
7525 dim,
7526 spacedim,
7527 typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type> &bem_values_gpu,
7528 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_handler,
7529 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_handler,
7530 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
7531 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7532 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
7533 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7534 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
7535 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,

7544 static_assert(
7545 std::is_same<
7546 real_type,
7547 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
7548
7549 const std::thread::id current_thread_id = std::this_thread::get_id();
7550 deallog << "WorkStream " << current_thread_id << " starts..." << std::endl;
7551
7557 PairCellWiseScratchData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> scratch_data(
7558 current_thread_id,
7559 kx_dof_handler.get_fe(),
7560 ky_dof_handler.get_fe(),
7561 mappings,
7562 bem_values);
7563 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> copy_data(

7565

7567 iter = range.begin();
7568 iter != range.end();
7569 iter++)
7570 {
7571 fill_far_field_hmatrix_leaf_node_with_aca_plus(
7572 (*iter),
7573 aca_config,

7575 kernel_factor,

7577 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
7578 bem_values,

7580 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
7581 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,

7583 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
7584 mappings,
7585 material_id_to_mapping_index,
7586 normal_detector,
7587 scratch_data,
7588 copy_data,
7589 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
7590 }
7591
7595 scratch_data.release();
7596 copy_data.release();
7597
7598 deallog << "WorkStream " << current_thread_id << " exits..." << std::endl;
7599}

7744template <int spacedim, typename RangeNumberType, typename KernelNumberType>
7745void
7746stabilize_near_field_hmatrices_for_hypersingular_kernel(
7747 const tbb::blocked_range<
7748 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator>
7749 &range,
7750 const std::vector<Vector<KernelNumberType>> &mass_vmult_weq,
7751 const KernelNumberType stabilization_factor,
7752 const bool enable_build_symmetric_hmat = true)
7753{
7754 for (typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator
7755 iter = range.begin();
7756 iter != range.end();
7757 iter++)
7758 {
7759 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *leaf_mat = (*iter);
7760 Assert(leaf_mat->get_type() == HMatrixType::FullMatrixType,
7761 ExcInternalError());
7762
7763 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> *row_index_range =
7764 leaf_mat->get_row_index_range();
7765 const std::array<types::global_dof_index, 2> *col_index_range =
7766 leaf_mat->get_col_index_range();
7767
7768 LAPACKFullMatrixExt<RangeNumberType> *fullmat =
7769 leaf_mat->get_fullmatrix();
7770
7771 if (enable_build_symmetric_hmat)
7772 {
7777 switch (leaf_mat->get_block_type())
7778 {
7779 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::diagonal_block: {
7784 Assert(leaf_mat->get_property() ==
7785 HMatrixSupport::Property::symmetric,
7786 ExcInvalidHMatrixProperty(leaf_mat->get_property()));
7787 Assert(fullmat->get_property() ==
7788 LAPACKSupport::Property::symmetric,
7789 ExcInvalidLAPACKFullMatrixProperty(
7790 fullmat->get_property()));
7791
7792 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
7793 {
7794 for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; j++)
7795 {
7801 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
7802 (*fullmat)(i, j) += stabilization_factor *
7803 vec((*row_index_range)[0] + i) *
7804 vec((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
7805 }
7806 }
7807
7808 break;
7809 }
7810 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::upper_triangular_block: {
7816 break;
7817 }
7818 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::lower_triangular_block: {
7824 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
7825 {
7826 for (size_t j = 0; j < fullmat->n(); j++)
7827 {
7828 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
7829 (*fullmat)(i, j) += stabilization_factor *
7830 vec((*row_index_range)[0] + i) *
7831 vec((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
7832 }
7833 }
7834
7835 break;
7836 }
7837 case HMatrixSupport::BlockType::undefined_block: {
7838 Assert(false,
7839 ExcInvalidHMatrixBlockType(
7840 leaf_mat->get_block_type()));
7841
7842 break;
7843 }
7844 }
7845 }
7846 else
7847 {
7852 for (size_t i = 0; i < fullmat->m(); i++)
7853 {
7854 for (size_t j = 0; j < fullmat->n(); j++)
7855 {
7856 for (const auto &vec : mass_vmult_weq)
7857 (*fullmat)(i, j) += stabilization_factor *
7858 vec((*row_index_range)[0] + i) *
7859 vec((*col_index_range)[0] + j);
7860 }
7861 }
7862 }
7863 }
7864}

7984 PairCellWisePerTaskData<dim, spacedim, KernelNumberType> copy_data(
7985 kx_dof_handler.get_fe(), ky_dof_handler.get_fe());
7986
7990 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDAPairCellWiseScratchData<
7991 dim,
7992 spacedim,
7993 DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
7994 scratch_data_gpu;
7995 scratch_data_gpu.allocate(scratch_data);
7996
7997 for (HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *leaf_mat : hmat.get_leaf_set())
7998 {
7999 fill_hmatrix_leaf_node_with_aca_plus(
8000 leaf_mat,
8001 aca_config,
8002 kernel,
8003 kernel_factor,
8004 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
8005 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
8006 bem_values_gpu,
8007 kx_dof_handler,
8008 ky_dof_handler,
8009 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8010 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8011 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
8012 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
8013 mappings,
8014 material_id_to_mapping_index,
8015 normal_detector,
8016 scratch_data,
8017 scratch_data_gpu,
8018 copy_data,
8019 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
8020 }
8021
8025 bem_values_gpu.release();
8026
8030 scratch_data.release();
8031 scratch_data_gpu.release(scratch_data.cuda_stream_handle);
8032 copy_data.release();
