8458template <int dim,
8459 int spacedim,
8460 template <int, typename>
8461 typename KernelFunctionType,
8462 typename RangeNumberType,
8463 typename KernelNumberType,
8464 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
8465void
8466fill_hmatrix_with_aca_plus_smp(
8467 const unsigned int thread_num,
8468 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> &hmat,
8469 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
8470 &aca_config,
8471 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
8472 &kernel,
8473 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
8474 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
8475 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
8476 const SauterQuadratureRule<dim> &sauter_quad_rule,
8477 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_handler,
8478 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_handler,
8479 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
8480 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8481 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
8482 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8483 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
8484 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
8485 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
8486 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
8487 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
8488 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
8489 const bool enable_build_symmetric_hmat = false)
8490{
8491 using real_type = typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type;
8492 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
8493 static_assert(
8494 std::is_same<
8495 real_type,
8496 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
8497
8498 LogStream::Prefix prefix_string("build_hmatrix_aca");
8499#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
8500 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_hmat");
8501#endif
8502
8503 Timer timer;
8504
8521 BEMValues<dim, spacedim, real_type> bem_values(
8522 kx_dof_handler.get_fe(),
8523 ky_dof_handler.get_fe(),
8524 mappings,
8525 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_same_panel,
8526 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_common_edge,
8527 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_common_vertex,
8528 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_regular);
8529
8530 bem_values.fill_shape_function_value_tables();
8531
8535 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<dim, spacedim, real_type> bem_values_gpu;
8536 bem_values_gpu.allocate_and_assign_from_host(bem_values);
8537
8538 timer.stop();
8539 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "compute BEM values");
8540
8545 timer.start();
8546
8547 const unsigned int block_size = ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_block_size();
8548 const unsigned int block_num = ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_block_num();
8549 const unsigned int batch_size = block_size * block_num;
8550 const unsigned int capacity =
8551 batch_size * ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_ring_buffer_n_batches() + 1;
8552 unsigned int producer_thread_num =
8553 std::max(static_cast<unsigned int>(4), thread_num / 2);
8554
8555 // Create ring buffers for various cell neighboring types.
8556 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8557 dim,
8558 spacedim,
8559 RangeNumberType,
8560 KernelNumberType>
8561 ring_buffer_for_same_panel;
8562 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.allocate(CellNeighboringType::SamePanel,
8563 batch_size,
8564 bem_values);
8565 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8566 dim,
8567 spacedim,
8568 RangeNumberType,
8569 KernelNumberType>
8570 ring_buffer_for_common_edge;
8571 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.allocate(CellNeighboringType::CommonEdge,
8572 batch_size,
8573 bem_values);
8574 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8575 dim,
8576 spacedim,
8577 RangeNumberType,
8578 KernelNumberType>
8579 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex;
8580 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.allocate(CellNeighboringType::CommonVertex,
8581 batch_size,
8582 bem_values);
8583 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8584 dim,
8585 spacedim,
8586 RangeNumberType,
8587 KernelNumberType>
8588 ring_buffer_for_regular;
8589 ring_buffer_for_regular.allocate(CellNeighboringType::Regular,
8590 batch_size,
8591 bem_values);
8592
8593 std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *> &near_field_leaf_set =
8594 hmat.get_near_field_leaf_set();
8595 const unsigned int near_field_set_size = near_field_leaf_set.size();
8596
8597 Assert(near_field_set_size > 0, ExcLowerRange(near_field_set_size, 1));
8598
8599 if (near_field_set_size < producer_thread_num)
8600 producer_thread_num = near_field_set_size;
8601
8602 std::vector<std::thread> producers;
8603 producers.reserve(producer_thread_num);
8604
8605 // Use sequence partition to generate closed ranges of near field H-matrix
8606 // nodes.
8607 std::vector<double> near_field_leaf_set_storage(near_field_set_size);
8608 hmat.compute_near_field_leaf_set_assembly_task_costs(
8609 near_field_leaf_set_storage);
8610 // Generate the cost function for sequence partition, which accumulates the
8611 // memory costs for all H-matrix leaf nodes in the closed range [i,j].
8612 auto near_field_storage_cost_func =
8613 [&near_field_leaf_set_storage](int64_t i, int64_t j) -> double {
8614 double sum = 0.0;
8615 for (int64_t k = i; k <= j; k++)
8616 {
8617 sum += near_field_leaf_set_storage[k];
8618 }
8619 return sum;
8620 };
8621
8622 SequencePartitioner<decltype(near_field_storage_cost_func)>
8623 near_field_storage_sp(near_field_set_size,
8624 producer_thread_num,
8625 near_field_storage_cost_func);
8626 near_field_storage_sp.partition();
8627 std::vector<std::pair<int64_t, int64_t>> near_field_partitions;
8628 near_field_storage_sp.get_partitions(near_field_partitions);
8629
8633#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
8634 nvtxRangePush("build_near_field_nodes");
8635#endif
8636 for (const auto &partition : near_field_partitions)
8637 {
8638 producers.emplace_back([&]() {
8639 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
8640 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_producer(
8641 near_field_leaf_set,
8642 partition.first,
8643 partition.second + 1,
8644 ring_buffer_for_same_panel,
8645 ring_buffer_for_common_edge,
8646 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex,
8647 ring_buffer_for_regular,
8648 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
8649 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
8650 bem_values,
8651 kx_dof_handler,
8652 ky_dof_handler,
8653 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8654 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8655 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
8656 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
8657 mappings,
8658 material_id_to_mapping_index,
8659 normal_detector,
8660 kernel.is_symmetric(),
8661 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
8662 });
8663 }
8664
8668 std::vector<std::thread> consumers;
8669 const unsigned int consumer_multiplicity =
8670 std::max(static_cast<unsigned int>(1), thread_num / 2 / 4);
8671 consumers.reserve(4 * consumer_multiplicity);
8672
8673 for (unsigned int m = 0; m < consumer_multiplicity; m++)
8674 {
8675 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
8676 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
8677 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
8678 kernel,
8679 kernel_factor,
8680 ring_buffer_for_same_panel,
8681 bem_values_gpu,
8682 block_size);
8683 });
8684
8685 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
8686 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
8687 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
8688 kernel,
8689 kernel_factor,
8690 ring_buffer_for_common_edge,
8691 bem_values_gpu,
8692 block_size);
8693 });
8694
8695 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
8696 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
8697 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
8698 kernel,
8699 kernel_factor,
8700 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex,
8701 bem_values_gpu,
8702 block_size);
8703 });
8704
8705 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
8706 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
8707 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
8708 kernel,
8709 kernel_factor,
8710 ring_buffer_for_regular,
8711 bem_values_gpu,
8712 block_size);
8713 });
8714 }
8715
8719 for (auto &producer : producers)
8720 producer.join();
8721
8722 {
8723 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_same_panel.buffer_lock);
8724 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
8725 }
8726 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
8727
8728 {
8729 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_common_edge.buffer_lock);
8730 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
8731 }
8732 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
8733
8734 {
8735 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.buffer_lock);
8736 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
8737 }
8738 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
8739
8740 {
8741 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_regular.buffer_lock);
8742 ring_buffer_for_regular.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
8743 }
8744 ring_buffer_for_regular.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
8745
8746 for (auto &consumer : consumers)
8747 consumer.join();
8748
8749#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
8750 nvtxRangePop(); // NVTX range: build_near_field_nodes
8751#endif
8752
8756 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.release();
8757 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.release();
8758 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.release();
8759 ring_buffer_for_regular.release();
8760
8761 timer.stop();
8762 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "build near field H-matrix nodes");
8763
8768 timer.start();
8769
8770 std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *> &far_field_leaf_set =
8771 hmat.get_far_field_leaf_set();
8772
8773 if (far_field_leaf_set.size() > 0)
8774 {
8775#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
8776 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_far_field_nodes");
8777#endif
8778
8779 const unsigned int grain_size =
8780 std::max(static_cast<unsigned long>(1),
8781 far_field_leaf_set.size() / thread_num / 2);
8782 tbb::parallel_for(
8783 tbb::blocked_range<
8784 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator>(
8785 far_field_leaf_set.begin(), far_field_leaf_set.end(), grain_size),
8786 [&](const tbb::blocked_range<typename std::vector<
8787 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator> &range) {
8788 fill_far_field_hmatrix_leaf_node_subrange_with_aca_plus<
8789 dim,
8790 spacedim,
8791 KernelFunctionType,
8792 RangeNumberType,
8793 KernelNumberType,
8794 SurfaceNormalDetector>(range,
8795 aca_config,
8796 kernel,
8797 kernel_factor,
8798 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
8799 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
8800 bem_values,
8801 bem_values_gpu,
8802 kx_dof_handler,
8803 ky_dof_handler,
8804 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8805 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8806 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
8807 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
8808 mappings,
8809 material_id_to_mapping_index,
8810 normal_detector,
8811 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
8812 },
8813 tbb::auto_partitioner());
8814 }
8815
8816 timer.stop();
8817 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "build far field H-matrix nodes");
8818
8822 bem_values_gpu.release();
8823}

8875template <int dim,
8876 int spacedim,
8877 template <int, typename>
8878 typename KernelFunctionType,
8879 typename RangeNumberType,
8880 typename KernelNumberType,
8881 typename SurfaceNormalDetector>
8882void
8883fill_hmatrix_with_aca_plus_smp(
8884 const unsigned int thread_num,
8885 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> &hmat,
8886 const ACAConfig<typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type>
8887 &aca_config,
8888 const KernelFunctionType<spacedim, DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType>>
8889 &kernel,
8890 const DeviceNumberType<KernelNumberType> kernel_factor,
8891 const std::vector<Vector<KernelNumberType>> &mass_vmult_weq,
8892 const KernelNumberType stabilization_factor,
8893 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
8894 const DoFToCellTopology<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
8895 const SauterQuadratureRule<dim> &sauter_quad_rule,
8896 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &kx_dof_handler,
8897 const DoFHandler<dim, spacedim> &ky_dof_handler,
8898 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
8899 *kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8900 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index>
8901 *ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
8902 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
8903 const std::vector<types::global_dof_index> &ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
8904 const std::vector<MappingInfo<dim, spacedim> *> &mappings,
8905 const std::map<types::material_id, unsigned int>
8906 &material_id_to_mapping_index,
8907 const SurfaceNormalDetector &normal_detector,
8908 const bool enable_build_symmetric_hmat = false)
8909{
8910 using real_type = typename numbers::NumberTraits<RangeNumberType>::real_type;
8911 static_assert(is_number_larger_or_equal<RangeNumberType, KernelNumberType>());
8912 static_assert(
8913 std::is_same<
8914 real_type,
8915 typename numbers::NumberTraits<KernelNumberType>::real_type>::value);
8916
8917 LogStream::Prefix prefix_string("build_hmatrix_aca with stabilization");
8918#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
8919 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_hmat_stab");
8920#endif
8921
8922 Timer timer;
8923
8941 BEMValues<dim, spacedim, real_type> bem_values(
8942 kx_dof_handler.get_fe(),
8943 ky_dof_handler.get_fe(),
8944 mappings,
8945 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_same_panel,
8946 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_common_edge,
8947 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_common_vertex,
8948 sauter_quad_rule.quad_rule_for_regular);
8949
8950 bem_values.fill_shape_function_value_tables();
8951
8955 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::CUDABEMValues<dim, spacedim, real_type> bem_values_gpu;
8956 bem_values_gpu.allocate_and_assign_from_host(bem_values);
8957
8958 timer.stop();
8959 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "compute BEM values");
8960
8965 timer.start();
8966
8967 const unsigned int block_size = ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_block_size();
8968 const unsigned int block_num = ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_block_num();
8969 const unsigned int batch_size = block_size * block_num;
8970 const unsigned int capacity =
8971 batch_size * ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_ring_buffer_n_batches() + 1;
8972 unsigned int producer_thread_num =
8973 std::max(static_cast<unsigned int>(4), thread_num / 2);
8974
8975 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8976 dim,
8977 spacedim,
8978 RangeNumberType,
8979 KernelNumberType>
8980 ring_buffer_for_same_panel;
8981 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.allocate(CellNeighboringType::SamePanel,
8982 batch_size,
8983 bem_values);
8984 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8985 dim,
8986 spacedim,
8987 RangeNumberType,
8988 KernelNumberType>
8989 ring_buffer_for_common_edge;
8990 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.allocate(CellNeighboringType::CommonEdge,
8991 batch_size,
8992 bem_values);
8993 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
8994 dim,
8995 spacedim,
8996 RangeNumberType,
8997 KernelNumberType>
8998 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex;
8999 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.allocate(CellNeighboringType::CommonVertex,
9000 batch_size,
9001 bem_values);
9002 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
9003 dim,
9004 spacedim,
9005 RangeNumberType,
9006 KernelNumberType>
9007 ring_buffer_for_regular;
9008 ring_buffer_for_regular.allocate(CellNeighboringType::Regular,
9009 batch_size,
9010 bem_values);
9011
9012 std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *> &near_field_leaf_set =
9013 hmat.get_near_field_leaf_set();
9014 const unsigned int near_field_set_size = near_field_leaf_set.size();
9015
9016 Assert(near_field_set_size > 0, ExcLowerRange(near_field_set_size, 1));
9017
9018 if (near_field_set_size < producer_thread_num)
9019 producer_thread_num = near_field_set_size;
9020
9021 std::vector<std::thread> producers;
9022 producers.reserve(producer_thread_num);
9023
9024 // Use sequence partition to generate closed ranges of near field H-matrix
9025 // nodes.
9026 std::vector<double> near_field_leaf_set_storage(near_field_set_size);
9027 hmat.compute_near_field_leaf_set_assembly_task_costs(
9028 near_field_leaf_set_storage);
9029 // Generate the cost function for sequence partition, which accumulates the
9030 // memory costs for all H-matrix leaf nodes in the closed range [i,j].
9031 auto near_field_storage_cost_func =
9032 [&near_field_leaf_set_storage](int64_t i, int64_t j) -> double {
9033 double sum = 0.0;
9034 for (int64_t k = i; k <= j; k++)
9035 {
9036 sum += near_field_leaf_set_storage[k];
9037 }
9038 return sum;
9039 };
9040
9041 SequencePartitioner<decltype(near_field_storage_cost_func)>
9042 near_field_storage_sp(near_field_set_size,
9043 producer_thread_num,
9044 near_field_storage_cost_func);
9045 near_field_storage_sp.partition();
9046 std::vector<std::pair<int64_t, int64_t>> near_field_partitions;
9047 near_field_storage_sp.get_partitions(near_field_partitions);
9048
9052#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9053 nvtxRangePush("build_near_field_nodes");
9054#endif
9055 for (const auto &partition : near_field_partitions)
9056 {
9057 producers.emplace_back([&]() {
9058 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9059 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_producer(
9060 near_field_leaf_set,
9061 partition.first,
9062 partition.second + 1,
9063 ring_buffer_for_same_panel,
9064 ring_buffer_for_common_edge,
9065 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex,
9066 ring_buffer_for_regular,
9067 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
9068 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
9069 bem_values,
9070 kx_dof_handler,
9071 ky_dof_handler,
9072 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9073 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9074 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
9075 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
9076 mappings,
9077 material_id_to_mapping_index,
9078 normal_detector,
9079 kernel.is_symmetric(),
9080 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
9081 });
9082 }
9083
9087 std::vector<std::thread> consumers;
9088 const unsigned int consumer_multiplicity =
9089 std::max(static_cast<unsigned int>(1), thread_num / 2 / 4);
9090 consumers.reserve(4 * consumer_multiplicity);
9091
9092 for (unsigned int m = 0; m < consumer_multiplicity; m++)
9093 {
9094 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9095 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9096 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9097 kernel,
9098 kernel_factor,
9099 ring_buffer_for_same_panel,
9100 bem_values_gpu,
9101 block_size);
9102 });
9103
9104 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9105 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9106 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9107 kernel,
9108 kernel_factor,
9109 ring_buffer_for_common_edge,
9110 bem_values_gpu,
9111 block_size);
9112 });
9113
9114 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9115 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9116 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9117 kernel,
9118 kernel_factor,
9119 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex,
9120 bem_values_gpu,
9121 block_size);
9122 });
9123
9124 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9125 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9126 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9127 kernel,
9128 kernel_factor,
9129 ring_buffer_for_regular,
9130 bem_values_gpu,
9131 block_size);
9132 });
9133 }
9134
9138 for (auto &producer : producers)
9139 producer.join();
9140
9141 {
9142 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_same_panel.buffer_lock);
9143 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9144 }
9145 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9146
9147 {
9148 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_common_edge.buffer_lock);
9149 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9150 }
9151 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9152
9153 {
9154 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.buffer_lock);
9155 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9156 }
9157 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9158
9159 {
9160 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_regular.buffer_lock);
9161 ring_buffer_for_regular.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9162 }
9163 ring_buffer_for_regular.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9164
9165 for (auto &consumer : consumers)
9166 consumer.join();
9167
9171 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.release();
9172 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.release();
9173 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.release();
9174 ring_buffer_for_regular.release();
9175
9176 if (mass_vmult_weq.size() > 0)
9177 {
9178#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9179 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("stab_near_field_nodes");
9180#endif
9181
9182 const unsigned int grain_size =
9183 std::max(static_cast<unsigned long>(1),
9184 near_field_leaf_set.size() / thread_num / 2);
9185 tbb::parallel_for(
9186 tbb::blocked_range<
9187 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator>(
9188 near_field_leaf_set.begin(), near_field_leaf_set.end(), grain_size),
9189 [&](const tbb::blocked_range<typename std::vector<
9190 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator> &range) {
9191 stabilize_near_field_hmatrices_for_hypersingular_kernel<
9192 spacedim,
9193 RangeNumberType,
9194 KernelNumberType>(range,
9195 mass_vmult_weq,
9196 stabilization_factor,
9197 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
9198 },
9199 tbb::auto_partitioner());
9200 }
9201
9202#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9203 nvtxRangePop(); // NVTX range: build_near_field_nodes
9204#endif
9205
9206 timer.stop();
9207 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "build near field H-matrix nodes");
9208
9213 timer.start();
9214
9215 std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *> &far_field_leaf_set =
9216 hmat.get_far_field_leaf_set();
9217
9218 if (far_field_leaf_set.size() > 0)
9219 {
9220#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9221 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_far_field_nodes");
9222#endif
9223
9224 const unsigned int grain_size =
9225 std::max(static_cast<unsigned long>(1),
9226 far_field_leaf_set.size() / thread_num / 2);
9227 tbb::parallel_for(
9228 tbb::blocked_range<
9229 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator>(
9230 far_field_leaf_set.begin(), far_field_leaf_set.end(), grain_size),
9231 [&](const tbb::blocked_range<typename std::vector<
9232 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator> &range) {
9233 fill_far_field_hmatrix_leaf_node_subrange_with_aca_plus<
9234 dim,
9235 spacedim,
9236 KernelFunctionType,
9237 RangeNumberType,
9238 KernelNumberType,
9239 SurfaceNormalDetector>(range,
9240 aca_config,
9241 kernel,
9242 kernel_factor,
9243 mass_vmult_weq,
9244 stabilization_factor,
9245 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
9246 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
9247 bem_values,
9248 bem_values_gpu,
9249 kx_dof_handler,
9250 ky_dof_handler,
9251 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9252 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9253 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
9254 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
9255 mappings,
9256 material_id_to_mapping_index,
9257 normal_detector,
9258 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
9259 },
9260 tbb::auto_partitioner());
9261 }
9262
9263 timer.stop();
9264 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "build far field H-matrix nodes");
9265
9269 bem_values_gpu.release();
9270}

9339 mass_matrix_factor,

9406 timer.stop();
9407 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "compute BEM values");

9413 timer.start();

9415 const unsigned int block_size = ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_block_size();
9416 const unsigned int block_num = ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_block_num();
9417 const unsigned int batch_size = block_size * block_num;
9418 const unsigned int capacity =
9419 batch_size * ConfigAccessor::get_near_field_ring_buffer_n_batches() + 1;
9420 unsigned int producer_thread_num =

9422
9423 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
9424 dim,
9425 spacedim,
9426 RangeNumberType,
9427 KernelNumberType>
9428 ring_buffer_for_same_panel;
9429 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.allocate(CellNeighboringType::SamePanel,
9430 batch_size,
9431 bem_values);
9432 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
9433 dim,
9434 spacedim,
9435 RangeNumberType,
9436 KernelNumberType>
9437 ring_buffer_for_common_edge;
9438 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.allocate(CellNeighboringType::CommonEdge,
9439 batch_size,
9440 bem_values);
9441 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
9442 dim,
9443 spacedim,
9444 RangeNumberType,
9445 KernelNumberType>
9446 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex;
9447 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.allocate(CellNeighboringType::CommonVertex,
9448 batch_size,
9449 bem_values);
9450 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::SauterQuadratureTaskRingBuffer<capacity,
9451 dim,
9452 spacedim,
9453 RangeNumberType,
9454 KernelNumberType>
9455 ring_buffer_for_regular;

9457 batch_size,

9459
9460 std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *> &near_field_leaf_set =
9461 hmat.get_near_field_leaf_set();
9462 const unsigned int near_field_set_size = near_field_leaf_set.size();
9463
9464 Assert(near_field_set_size > 0, ExcLowerRange(near_field_set_size, 1));
9465
9466 if (near_field_set_size < producer_thread_num)
9467 producer_thread_num = near_field_set_size;
9468
9469 std::vector<std::thread> producers;
9470 producers.reserve(producer_thread_num);
9471
9472 // Use sequence partition to generate closed ranges of near field H-matrix
9473 // nodes.
9474 std::vector<double> near_field_leaf_set_storage(near_field_set_size);
9475 hmat.compute_near_field_leaf_set_assembly_task_costs(
9476 near_field_leaf_set_storage);
9477 // Generate the cost function for sequence partition, which accumulates the
9478 // memory costs for all H-matrix leaf nodes in the closed range [i,j].
9479 auto near_field_storage_cost_func =
9480 [&near_field_leaf_set_storage](int64_t i, int64_t j) -> double {
9481 double sum = 0.0;
9482 for (int64_t k = i; k <= j; k++)
9483 {
9484 sum += near_field_leaf_set_storage[k];
9485 }
9486 return sum;
9487 };
9488
9489 SequencePartitioner<decltype(near_field_storage_cost_func)>
9490 near_field_storage_sp(near_field_set_size,
9491 producer_thread_num,
9492 near_field_storage_cost_func);
9493 near_field_storage_sp.partition();
9494 std::vector<std::pair<int64_t, int64_t>> near_field_partitions;
9495 near_field_storage_sp.get_partitions(near_field_partitions);
9496
9500#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9501 nvtxRangePush("build_near_field_nodes");
9502#endif
9503 for (const auto &partition : near_field_partitions)
9504 {
9505 producers.emplace_back([&]() {
9506 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9507 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_producer(
9508 near_field_leaf_set,
9509 partition.first,
9510 partition.second + 1,
9511 ring_buffer_for_same_panel,
9512 ring_buffer_for_common_edge,
9513 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex,
9514 ring_buffer_for_regular,
9515 mass_matrix_factor,
9516 kx_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
9517 ky_dof_to_cell_topo.topology,
9518 bem_values,
9519 mass_matrix_quadrature_formula,
9520 kx_dof_handler,
9521 ky_dof_handler,
9522 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9523 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9524 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
9525 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
9526 mappings,
9527 material_id_to_mapping_index,
9528 normal_detector,
9529 kernel.is_symmetric(),
9530 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
9531 });
9532 }
9533
9537 std::vector<std::thread> consumers;
9538 const unsigned int consumer_multiplicity =
9539 std::max(static_cast<unsigned int>(1), thread_num / 2 / 4);
9540 consumers.reserve(4 * consumer_multiplicity);
9541
9542 for (unsigned int m = 0; m < consumer_multiplicity; m++)
9543 {
9544 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9545 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9546 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9547 kernel,
9548 kernel_factor,
9549 ring_buffer_for_same_panel,
9550 bem_values_gpu,
9551 block_size);
9552 });
9553
9554 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9555 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9556 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9557 kernel,
9558 kernel_factor,
9559 ring_buffer_for_common_edge,
9560 bem_values_gpu,
9561 block_size);
9562 });
9563
9564 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9565 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9566 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9567 kernel,
9568 kernel_factor,
9569 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex,
9570 bem_values_gpu,
9571 block_size);
9572 });
9573
9574 consumers.emplace_back([&]() {
9575 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::
9576 sauter_quadrature_for_near_field_matrix_entries_consumer(
9577 kernel,
9578 kernel_factor,
9579 ring_buffer_for_regular,
9580 bem_values_gpu,
9581 block_size);
9582 });
9583 }
9584
9588 for (auto &producer : producers)
9589 producer.join();
9590
9591 {
9592 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_same_panel.buffer_lock);
9593 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9594 }
9595 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9596
9597 {
9598 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_common_edge.buffer_lock);
9599 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9600 }
9601 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9602
9603 {
9604 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.buffer_lock);
9605 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9606 }
9607 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9608
9609 {
9610 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lg(ring_buffer_for_regular.buffer_lock);
9611 ring_buffer_for_regular.if_all_near_field_hmat_entries_added = true;
9612 }
9613 ring_buffer_for_regular.batch_task_ready.notify_all();
9614
9615 for (auto &consumer : consumers)
9616 consumer.join();
9617
9618#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9619 nvtxRangePop(); // NVTX range: build_near_field_nodes
9620#endif
9621
9625 ring_buffer_for_same_panel.release();
9626 ring_buffer_for_common_edge.release();
9627 ring_buffer_for_common_vertex.release();
9628 ring_buffer_for_regular.release();
9629
9630 timer.stop();
9631 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "build near field H-matrix nodes");
9632
9637 timer.start();
9638
9639 std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *> &far_field_leaf_set =
9640 hmat.get_far_field_leaf_set();
9641
9642 if (far_field_leaf_set.size() > 0)
9643 {
9644#if ENABLE_NVTX == 1
9645 HierBEM::CUDAWrappers::NVTXRange nvtx_range("build_far_field_nodes");
9646#endif
9647
9648 const unsigned int grain_size =
9649 std::max(static_cast<unsigned long>(1),
9650 far_field_leaf_set.size() / thread_num / 2);
9651 tbb::parallel_for(
9652 tbb::blocked_range<
9653 typename std::vector<HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator>(
9654 far_field_leaf_set.begin(), far_field_leaf_set.end(), grain_size),
9655 [&](const tbb::blocked_range<typename std::vector<
9656 HMatrix<spacedim, RangeNumberType> *>::iterator> &range) {
9657 fill_far_field_hmatrix_leaf_node_subrange_with_aca_plus<
9658 dim,
9659 spacedim,
9660 KernelFunctionType,
9661 RangeNumberType,
9662 KernelNumberType,
9663 SurfaceNormalDetector>(range,
9664 aca_config,
9665 kernel,
9666 kernel_factor,
9667 kx_dof_to_cell_topo,
9668 ky_dof_to_cell_topo,
9669 bem_values,
9670 bem_values_gpu,
9671 kx_dof_handler,
9672 ky_dof_handler,
9673 kx_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9674 ky_map_from_local_to_full_dof_indices,
9675 kx_dof_i2e_numbering,
9676 ky_dof_i2e_numbering,
9677 mappings,
9678 material_id_to_mapping_index,
9679 normal_detector,
9680 enable_build_symmetric_hmat);
9681 },
9682 tbb::auto_partitioner());
9683 }
9684
9685 timer.stop();
9686 print_wall_time(deallog, timer, "build far field H-matrix nodes");
9687
9691 bem_values_gpu.release();
9692}
